latest_release.body:
## Awesome Android Root 6.2

This release focuses on keeping the collection useful and current: it adds 20 entries, removes 73 previously listed projects, and refreshes descriptions and links throughout the directory. 

### Added apps and modules

#### Root management

- **[LSP Store](https://github.com/Xposed-Modules-Repo/io.github.tophtab.lspstore)** - Browse and update LSPosed modules.
- **[Modules Manager](https://github.com/rushiranpise/lsposed-modules-manager)** - Find, install and update Xposed and LSPosed modules.
- **[Detection](https://github.com/rushiranpise/detection)** - An index of apps and tools for testing root, hooking, bootloader and device integrity detection.
- **[susfs4ksu-lkm](https://github.com/inforcqb/susfs4ksu-for-lkm/)** - SUSFS as a loadable kernel module for supported GKI/CFI devices.

#### Development and utilities

- **[AA Experiments](https://github.com/HighwindBR/AA-Experiments)** - View and change Android Auto experiment flags.
- **[Lifeline](https://github.com/techbysakh963/Lifeline)** - Use an Android phone to help repair a PC over USB, with supported tethering, keyboard and boot modes.
- **[StethoX](https://github.com/5ec1cff/StethoX)** - Inspect apps through Chrome DevTools over ADB.
- **[USB-Arsenal](https://github.com/ravindu644/USB-Arsenal)** - Present a rooted phone as USB devices such as a drive, network adapter or keyboard, with kernel support.

#### App modifications

- **[GText](https://github.com/comewhy/com.comewhy.gtext)** - Replace text displayed by apps and the system UI using custom rules.
- **[ReWeibo](https://github.com/Xposed-Modules-Repo/com.tianqianguai.reweibo)** - Remove ads and customize the Weibo Lite timeline.
- **[Wren](https://github.com/Xposed-Modules-Repo/top.haif.xposed)** - Chat and media tweaks for WeChat.
- **[YouTube Hide Ads](https://github.com/MrxSiN/YouTubeHideAds)** - Hide YouTube ads, skip supported sponsor segments and add playback controls.

#### Privacy, networking and security

- **[App Clone](https://github.com/doccstat/appclone)** - Run and manage additional copies of apps.
- **[Doppel](https://github.com/akano12/Doppel)** - Supply selected apps with substitute identifiers, location and other data.
- **[VirtualRegion](https://github.com/Xposed-Modules-Repo/io.github.zhou6514ctrl.virtualregion)** - Configure virtual location, connectivity and regional information for apps.
- **[QCOM Band Menu](https://github.com/Fronsipswu/qcom-band-menu)** - Select network modes and bands on supported Qualcomm devices and inspect modem information.
- **[WPAForge](https://github.com/wlmosv-png/wpaforge)** - Wi-Fi auditing tools for rooted Android. Use only on networks you own or are authorized to test.

#### Other additions

- **[HyperEars](https://github.com/silverpoetry/HyperEars)** - Show supported third-party Bluetooth headphone controls in the HyperOS device center.
- **[MI Screen HDR Enhanced](https://github.com/TIMENEXSakura/MI-Screen-HDR-Enhanced)** - Preserve HDR brightness information in Xiaomi screenshots.
- **[CheatDroid](https://android-cheats.com/)** - Edit local game data and inspect or change values in running games on rooted devices.

### Removed from the collection

A maintenance pass removed older entries (last commit before `2nd November 2025`), while other entries were removed because their sources were no longer available. Removal from the directory does **not** necessarily mean a project is unsafe or unusable.

- **Ad blocking:** Systemless hosts KernelSU module, systemless-adblocker.
- **App modifications:** Apk Protection Patch, E-Government Liberator, EDS NG Crack, G-News Control, Keyboard GPT, MaskWechat, OnePlus 8 Series and 9R Camera Unlocker, WePadBridge, WeiboHelper, XAudioCapture, XSpoofSignatures.
- **Audio:** JamesDSP.
- **Customization:** AlwaysOn, FontLoader, Hide Navbar Keyboard, Magisk Fonts, Magisk-Minecraft-Font, MiSans, NovaInstaller, Pixel Launcher Mods, Volume Scroll.

[![Website](https://img.shields.io/badge/Website-awesome--android--root.xyz%E2%86%97-blue?style=for-the-badge&logo=googlechrome&logoColor=white)](https://awesome-android-root.xyz/) [![GitHub Repo stars](https://img.shields.io/github/stars/awesome-android-root/awesome-android-root?logo=github&style=for-the-badge&color=blue&cacheSeconds=3600)](https://github.com/awesome-android-root/awesome-android-root) [![Apps and Modules](https://img.shields.io/badge/dynamic/json?url=https%3A%2F%2Fawesome-android-root.xyz%2Fcount.json&query=%24.total&label=apps%20%26%20modules&color=blue&logo=android&style=for-the-badge)](https://awesome-android-root.xyz/apps-and-modules/) [![Codeberg Mirror](https://img.shields.io/badge/Codeberg-Mirror-2185D0?style=for-the-badge&logo=codeberg&logoColor=white)](https://codeberg.org/awesome-android-root/awesome-android-root/)
## What is Awesome Android Root? Awesome Android Root is a community-curated knowledge base for **rooting Android devices and getting the most out of root access**: - **Rooting guides** - Magisk, KernelSU, APatch, LSPosed, bootloader unlocking, and device-specific walkthroughs (Pixel, Samsung, Xiaomi, OnePlus, Nothing, Motorola). - **Apps & Modules database** - 750+ curated apps and modules with source links, store badges, and license information. - **Tutorials, FAQs & troubleshooting** - ad blocking, debloating, Play Integrity, bootloop recovery, and more. Every entry links to its primary source (GitHub, F-Droid, or the project site) with license and framework badges, so you can verify a tool before installing it. **New to rooting?** Start with the [Rooting Guides](docs/rooting-guides/index.md) and read the [FAQ](docs/faqs.md) before touching the bootloader. ## 🌐 Use the Website The collection is easier to browse on the **[website ↗](https://awesome-android-root.xyz)**, which adds instant search across every app, module, and guide, clean per-category navigation, and works as an installable PWA. ## Apps & Modules by Category Entries live in [`docs/apps-and-modules/`](docs/apps-and-modules/index.md), the collection's source of truth.
